a.xlink:title: Completes an accepted command that has no command-specific result type.
Registers the complete queued-delivery protocol exactly once per process.
Consumes a producer batch and acknowledges its ID exactly once.
Returns the elapsed time between the first and last saved packets.
Releases the current source and returns the reader to its empty state.
Finalizes metrics and stops the rate timer.
True while the adapter owns a bound transport.
Notifies observers that a datagram was received.
Replaces any loaded session and publishes its first record, if present.
Stops the presentation clock while preserving the current position.
Applies the pending operation only when token matches the active drain.
Clamps to the session duration and publishes the frame at or before the target.
Sets a finite, strictly positive multiplier for presentation-clock progress.
Stops playback and returns the position and displayed frame to the start.
